transcript:
# Municipal Building Committee:
# Malden River Works Salt Shed & Boathouse
# Minutes

| June 4, 2026 | 12PM | Virtual Teams Meeting |
|---|---|---|

https://teams.microsoft.com/meet/26476107111150?p=tcy9yoBIOrkfVDsjS3

Meeting called to order by Rebekah McPheeters at 12:05PM.

## Roll Call

- Deborah Burke - Present
- Peg Crowe - Present
- Amanda Linehan - Present
- Nelson Miller - Present
- Paul Myers - Absent
- Eric Rubin - Present
- Stephen Winslow – Absent for roll call, joined later.

## Committee to Elect a Chair

- Amanda nominated Nelson to be the chair of this committee.
- Peg seconded the nomination and Nelson accepted the nomination.
- The nomination was put to a roll call vote: All present members voted yes.
- Nelson noted that Bekah will still facilitate agendas, minutes, and posting meetings.
- The committee decided to elect a vice chair in the event of Nelson's absence.
- Deb nominated Eric to be the vice chair of the committee.
- Nelson seconded the nomination and Eric accepted the nomination.
- The nomination was put to a roll call vote: All present members voted yes.

## Malden River Works Salt Shed & Boathouse Project Updates

Sustainability & Grants Manager Rebekah McPheeters to provide high level project updates.

- Invoices
  - designLAB invoice for services to April 30: $63,090.00
    - Schematic design (first 50%)
    - Construction documents
    - Bidding and CA preparation
  - Invoice for services to May 31: $63,090
    - Schematic design (second 50%)
    - Construction documents
    - Bidding and CA preparation
  - Eric made a motion to approve the invoices for payment
  - Peg asked a question about billing: Will the billing be by phase, and will the amounts be identical every time?
    - Sam (designLAB) noted that designLAB just finished schematic design, which was billed in two parts (first 50% and second 50%), but that the invoices will fluctuate a bit once we get into construction.
    - Nelson requested that Bekah put together a visual for the next call that will show work completion percentages and statuses.
  - Peg seconded the motion to approve the invoices for payment
  - Approval of the invoices was voted on by roll call vote: All present members voted yes.
- At the next meeting, the committee will need to vote to approve the draft minutes from May and June.

## Committee to Schedule Call to Review Construction Estimates

- Sam (designLAB) stated that the cost estimates should arrive from their sub at any minute, and he suggested that the committee schedule a follow-up meeting in a week or two to review them.
- Nelson noted that the next scheduled meeting fell on July 2, a City holiday, so it needed to be rescheduled anyways.
- The committee elected to reschedule that meeting to June 17 at 1PM on Teams.

## Adjournment

Eric motioned to adjourn and Nelson seconded. The meeting adjourned at 12:23PM.

*If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please contact Maria Luise, ADA Compliance Coordinator at mluise@cityofmalden.org or 781-397-7000 Ext. 2005*

*For instructions on enabling live translated captions in Teams, please visit: www.cityofmalden.org/captions*
headline: Elected a chair and vice chair, approved designLAB invoices for payment, and rescheduled the next meeting to June 17.
summary: The committee elected Nelson Miller as chair and Eric Rubin as vice chair by roll call vote. It approved designLAB invoices totaling $63,090.00 for services through April 30 and $63,090 for services through May 31 by roll call vote. Because the next scheduled meeting fell on a City holiday, the committee moved it to June 17 at 1PM on Teams to review upcoming construction cost estimates.
decisions: Elected Nelson Miller as chair by roll call vote, all present members voting yes.
Elected Eric Rubin as vice chair by roll call vote, all present members voting yes.
Approved the designLAB invoices for payment ($63,090.00 for services to April 30 and $63,090 for services to May 31) by roll call vote, all present members voting yes.
Rescheduled the next meeting from July 2 to June 17 at 1PM on Teams.
